parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Differentiate to obtain $4x+\tfrac12x^{-2}$ — B1. OE; condone $+cx^{-2}$.
Equate first derivative to zero and solve $4x+1/(2x^2)=0$ as far as $x^3=k$, $k$ negative and non-zero — M1. Not given if ‘$c$’ used.
$x=-1/2$ and $y=9/2$ — A1. OE; B1 SC if no visible solution of the cubic.
Total: 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Differentiate their first derivative and substitute their $x$; substitution may be implied by a correct inequality or value — M1. Must differentiate one term correctly. Expect $4-x^{-3}=12$ at $x=-1/2$; alternatively substitute values into $dy/dx$, one value $x<-1/2$ and one $-1/2<x<0$.
Conclude minimum — A1. Following correct work only.
Total: 2.
